enso.advisory_text: 30 June 2026 : El Niño conditions are present in the tropical Pacific. Climate models suggest El Niño will likely intensify over the next few seasons and persist until early next year. A strong El Niño is likely to emerge by the Aug-Sep-Oct season (69%), and a very strong El Niño is favored during the Oct-Nov-Dec and Nov-Dec-Jan seasons (>62%).(updated 24 June 2026) Trunkline No.: (02)8284-0800  local 4920 and 4921
